fixture_bootstrap.injection: Opted-in loopback HTML only: inline script as the first child of head, before deferred application scripts. Its added HTML, DOM node and execution cost remain in the measurement.
fixture_bootstrap.transformation: Insert ASCII zeroes immediately after the original sign until the numeric lexeme has fixed width. Preserve every original mantissa/fraction/exponent character and ms suffix; require Object.is numeric equality, including negative zero.
fixture_bootstrap.other_calls: Delegate all other property calls with original receiver, arguments, priority and return value.
fixture_bootstrap.invalid_input: Remove documentElement and throw; declared interaction targets become unavailable.
fixture_bootstrap.unchanged: No rounding, phase freezing, metric/guard rewriting, performance.now patch, animation disabling, or production asset change.
